Cell.Data: What / How We Are Using It
Primary 100 MHz clock driving CPU, AXI crossbar, DMA, CNN, Distance, and peripherals.
Main chip reset. When 0, resets CPU pipeline, bus arbiters, and registers to defaults.
Resets the on-chip RISC-V debug module and JTAG TAP without resetting the CPU.
Serial wire sending text to screen (prints 26 boot, inference, and test pass lines).
Serial wire receiving commands or image data from external PC into UART RX FIFO.
Physical output pins showing progress: 0x01 (boot), 0x02 (DMA done), 0x04 (CNN done), 0x55 (all pass).
Physical inputs for buttons/sensors; passed through on-chip 2-stage synchronizer.
Controls external bi-directional chip pad drivers (1=output drive, 0=high-Z input).
External pin pulses high when DMA block transfer (256-byte image) finishes.
External pin pulses high when CNN feature extraction inference finishes.
External pin pulses high when Manhattan distance scoring and threshold comparison finish.
External pin asserts high when UART TX FIFO is empty or RX byte arrives.
External pin asserts high when 64-bit timer reaches compare target (MTIME >= MTIMECMP).
External pin pulses high when an enabled GPIO input pin detects edge/level transition.
External machine timer interrupt input line wired into the VeeR-EL2 CPU.
External software / inter-processor interrupt line wired into the VeeR-EL2 CPU.
JTAG test clock for OpenOCD/GDB on-chip debugger access.
JTAG test mode select line driving state transitions of the 16-state TAP.
JTAG serial data input carrying CPU debug instructions and register read/write commands.
JTAG asynchronous reset pin to force TAP controller into Test-Logic-Reset state.
JTAG serial data output returning CPU registers, program counter, and memory values.
Enables the external TDO pad driver buffer only when shifting data out.
External hardware signal to request CPU to pause instruction fetch and halt.
CPU output signal confirming that the core has safely halted.
Continuous status output flag indicating whether the CPU core is currently halted.
External hardware signal to resume execution of a halted CPU core.
CPU output signal confirming that the core has resumed active instruction execution.
Status output signal indicating whether the CPU is halted in JTAG hardware debug mode.
Check reset defaults (0x0) and read/write access to DMA registers (CTRL, STATUS, SRC_ADDR, DST_ADDR, LENGTH).
Writes base addresses and lengths; reads back registers to verify setup.
Issues AXI-Lite read/write cycles; checks register flip-flops and OKAY responses.
Check 16-byte (4-word) memory-to-memory copy between DMEM source and destination.
Sets DMA_SRC_ADDR, DMA_DST_ADDR, DMA_LENGTH=16, triggers START, and polls STATUS.
Monitors DMA master read/write bursts on internal bus; checks destination equals source byte-for-byte.
Internal (On-chip DMEM & internal AXI master bus)
Check 256-byte bulk transfer of 16x16 INT8 image from DMEM to CNN SRAM buffer (0x2000_3100).
Sets SRC=&test_image, DST=0x20003100, LENGTH=256, START=1; verifies completion status.
Monitors burst writes; verifies all 256 bytes are loaded into CNN SRAM buffer without stall.
Internal (On-chip DMEM to on-chip CNN SRAM buffer)
Check transfer of 13 bytes (3 full 32-bit words + 1 byte) with byte strobes.
Configures DMA_LENGTH=13; checks destination buffer after completion.
Asserts words 0-2 write with wstrb=4'hF and word 3 with wstrb=4'h1; checks other bytes untouched.
Check that dedicated interrupt pin dma_irq_o pulses high when transfer completes.
Enables interrupt bit in CTRL (IRQ_EN=1); services interrupt or waits for completion flag.
Monitors physical dma_irq_o pin on chip boundary; checks pin rises from 0 to 1 upon completion.
Check Write-1-to-Clear (W1C) clears status flags and drops dma_irq_o back to 0.
Writes '1' to STATUS.DONE bit after transfer completes to acknowledge interrupt.
Probes dma_irq_o pin and STATUS register; verifies pin drops from 1 to 0 immediately on W1C write.
Fault injection: Program unaligned source address (0x1000_0003) and verify error latching.
Configures unaligned address; checks STATUS register for error code.
Verifies DMA FSM latches STATUS.ERROR=1 with ERROR_CODE=1 and blocks bus master requests.
Fault injection: Program LENGTH=0 and verify transfer rejection.
Configures LENGTH=0, START=1; reads back error status.
Verifies DMA aborts transfer without issuing bus transactions; asserts ERROR_CODE=1.
Fault injection: Write START=1 while DMA is already busy running a transfer.
Writes START=1 twice consecutively without waiting for completion.
Verifies ongoing transfer finishes safely; second command is dropped with ERROR_CODE=4.
Check soft reset recovery during an active bulk transfer.
Sets CTRL.SOFT_RESET=1 while transfer is running.
Verifies FSM immediately halts, cancels master requests, and resets internal counters to IDLE.
Check 8-bit signed multiplication and 32-bit accumulation datapath with synchronous clear.
Drives signed INT8 pixel and weight inputs; checks product accumulation and clear_acc reset.
Check 3x3 2D convolution on 16x16 image with 4 parallel filters (produces 784 activations).
Feeds test image and filter weights; compares all 784 output features against Python golden model.
Internal (On-chip sliding window buffers & MAC array)
Check element-wise Rectified Linear Unit activation (clamping negative numbers to 0).
Drives signed positive and negative values; verifies negative values clamp to 0 and positive values pass.
Check 2x2 max pooling with stride 2 across 784 inputs (reduces to 196 features).
Applies 14x14 feature maps per filter; verifies non-overlapping 2x2 max selection into 196 outputs.
Check Fully Connected matrix multiplication (196 inputs x 16 neurons) with bias addition.
Applies 196 features and 16x196 weights; checks that output 16-D embedding matches golden dot products.
Check direct AXI writes and reads to the CNN 256-byte image SRAM buffer (0x2000_3100 - 0x2000_31FC).
Writes known pixel array into buffer address 0x2000_3100; reads back data to verify SRAM integrity.
Monitors AXI writes to buffer range; checks SRAM memory array contents match written pixels.
Check complete CNN inference trigger, busy polling, and 16-element embedding vector generation.
Sets DIM_CFG=16x16, EMBED_LEN=16, triggers START=1, polls STATUS.DONE, and reads embedding registers (0x20-0x5C).
Monitors CNN AXI slave transactions; verifies pipeline execution cycles; checks embedding values are non-zero.
Check assertion of dedicated completion interrupt pin cnn_irq_o when inference finishes.
Configures CNN_CTRL with IRQ_EN=1; waits for hardware completion.
Probes physical cnn_irq_o output pin; checks pin asserts high when STATUS.DONE=1.
Fault injection: Program invalid image dimensions or embedding length and check error handling.
Writes illegal dimension value to DIM_CFG; reads STATUS register.
Verifies CNN detects illegal configuration, asserts STATUS.ERROR=1 with ERROR_CODE=3, and aborts start.
Check hardware calculation of Manhattan (L1) distance: sum(|query[i] - ref[i]|) for 16 elements.
Loads query and reference vectors into IP slots; triggers calculation.
Compares hardware computed distance in MIN_DISTANCE register against software reference calculation.
Check classification when distance <= threshold (Expected: RESULT=1 for MATCH / NORMAL).
Sets matching reference vector, sets threshold=50, starts engine, verifies RESULT==1 and MIN_DISTANCE==0.
Monitors Distance AXI registers; checks comparator asserts RESULT=1 when distance <= threshold.
Check classification when distance > threshold (Expected: RESULT=0 for ANOMALY).
Sets divergent reference vector, sets threshold=50, starts engine, verifies RESULT==0 and MIN_DISTANCE==800.
Monitors Distance AXI registers; checks comparator asserts RESULT=0 when distance > threshold.
Check assertion of dedicated completion interrupt pin dist_irq_o when distance scoring finishes.
Configures DIST_CTRL with IRQ_EN=1; triggers scoring; clears interrupt via W1C.
Probes physical dist_irq_o output pin; verifies pin rises to 1 on completion and drops to 0 on W1C.
Fault injection: Program unsupported metric index into DIST_METRIC and verify error response.
Writes unsupported metric code (e.g. 5) into DIST_METRIC register.
Verifies IP rejects configuration, asserts STATUS.ERROR=1 with ERROR_CODE=4, and refuses execution.
Check programming of UART baud rate divisor latch (divisor = 16) and line control register (8N1).
Writes LCR=0x80 (DLAB enable), writes BAUD_DIV=16, restores LCR=0x03 (8 data bits, 1 stop bit, no parity).
Monitors internal AXI writes to UART registers 0x2000_0008 and 0x2000_000C; verifies divisor latch value.
Check physical serial transmission of ASCII characters over uart_tx_o pin at exact baud timing.
Calls uart_putc() / uart_puts() to transmit string messages to console.
Probes physical uart_tx_o output wire; deserializes start bit, 8 data bits, and stop bit at 170 ns/bit; validates text.
Check UART Line Status Register (LSR) transmitter holding register empty (THRE) and transmitter empty (TEMT).
Polls LSR register until THRE bit is 1 before writing next character into THR.
Monitors AXI reads to LSR (0x2000_0014); checks THRE drops to 0 when FIFO is written and returns to 1 when empty.
Check assertion of uart_irq_o pin when TX FIFO is empty or RX data is received.
Enables UART interrupts via IER register; handles interrupt or polls status.
Probes physical uart_irq_o output pin; checks pin asserts upon configured UART trigger condition.
Check continuous 64-bit real-time counter (MTIME) incrementation based on system clock.
Reads MTIME counter registers twice and verifies time progression.
Monitors internal 64-bit timer counter registers; verifies increment rate matches prescaler setting.
Check assertion of timer_irq_o pin when MTIME counter reaches comparator value (MTIME >= MTIMECMP).
Programs MTIMECMP = MTIME + 100; enables timer interrupt; waits for interrupt.
Probes physical timer_irq_o output pin; verifies pin rises to 1 exactly when counter matches compare register.
Check 32-bit pin direction configuration via GPIO_EN register (input vs push-pull output).
Writes direction mask to GPIO_EN (0x2000_2080); verifies output enables.
Probes internal direction control bus gpio_dir_o[31:0]; checks pins configure correctly as inputs or outputs.
Check driving arbitrary test patterns and stage indicators onto physical gpio_o[31:0] pins.
Writes progress status to GPIO_OUT: 0x01 (boot), 0x02 (DMA done), 0x04 (CNN done), 0x55 (all pass).
Probes physical gpio_o[31:0] output pins on chip boundary; asserts pin levels match written values.
Check atomic bit manipulation registers: GPIO_SET (0x200), GPIO_CLEAR (0x280), and GPIO_TOGGLE (0x300).
Writes single bitmasks to SET, CLEAR, and TOGGLE registers without read-modify-write software overhead.
Monitors AXI writes to atomic offsets; asserts that target bits on gpio_o update while other bits remain unchanged.
External (Directly changes physical gpio_o output pins)
Check external signal sampling on physical gpio_i[31:0] pins through 2-stage flip-flop synchronizer.
Reads GPIO_IN register (0x2000_2000) to inspect external switch/pin states.
Drives asynchronous digital signals onto physical gpio_i pins; checks 2-stage synchronizer removes metastability.
Check generation of gpio_irq_o pin on configurable rising-edge, falling-edge, or level triggers on input pins.
Enables GPIO interrupt mask; reads interrupt status; clears interrupt via W1C.
Drives pulse transitions on gpio_i; probes physical gpio_irq_o pin; verifies interrupt asserts and clears cleanly.
External (Physical gpio_i pin transition -> gpio_irq_o pin)
Check address decoding and routing from CPU master (S00) to all 8 slave peripheral targets (M00-M07).
Issues read/write accesses to all 8 base addresses: IMEM, DMEM, UART, Timer, GPIO, CNN, Distance, and DMA.
Monitors select lines and handshakes on all 8 slave interfaces (m00_axi through m07_axi); verifies 1-to-1 routing.
Check generation of DECERR (2'b11) response when accessing unmapped address space (e.g. 0x3000_0000).
Attempts read or write access to unmapped memory address.
Captures write response bresp and read response rresp; asserts interconnect returns 2'b11 without bus hang.
Internal (On-chip crossbar default error slave logic)
Check round-robin bus arbitration when CPU (S00) and DMA (S01) issue concurrent accesses to shared DMEM (M01).
Initiates DMA background transfer to DMEM while CPU actively reads instructions and data.
Monitors simultaneous request lines; verifies round-robin arbiter grants alternating access without starving either master.
Internal (On-chip crossbar arbiter logic & grant handshakes)
Check valid/ready flow control and stall handling across all AXI channels during burst transactions.
Issues continuous back-to-back memory and register transfers.
Randomly asserts/deasserts ready signals; verifies master correctly holds valid and data until ready is high.
Check Instruction Memory dual-port operation: CPU IFU instruction fetches and LSU/DMA data reads/writes.
Executes code from IMEM while testbench preloads hex data.
Verifies simultaneous IFU fetch and AXI slave access to IMEM (0x0000_0000 - 0x0000_FFFF) without conflict.
Check Data Memory byte-level access using 4-bit write strobes (wstrb) for 8-bit, 16-bit, and 32-bit accesses.
Performs uint8_t, uint16_t, and uint32_t stores and loads in DMEM (0x1000_0000 - 0x1000_FFFF).
Checks that only enabled byte lanes in memory are modified; non-targeted bytes remain preserved.
Internal (On-chip 64 KB SRAM byte-enable mask logic)
Check VeeR-EL2 CPU boot from hardware reset, instruction fetch from 0x0000_0000, and stack initialization.
crt0.s initializes stack pointer sp to 0x1000_FFF0, configures MRAC CSR (0x5555556A), and calls main().
Deasserts rst_l; tracks CPU program counter (ifu_i0_pc); verifies execution starts at 0x0000_0000.
Internal (CPU reset vector logic & pipeline registers)
Check CPU firmware execution logs system progress, embeddings, and results via UART serial output.
Firmware executes print routines outputting 26 structured log lines to the console.
UART monitor captures all characters from physical uart_tx_o pin; verifies 26 complete lines and pass string.
Check full autonomous pipeline classifying a normal image sample: DMA copy -> CNN inference -> Distance Match.
Orchestrates DMA transfer, CNN start, loads matching reference embedding, validates RESULT==1, logs PASS.
Scoreboard captures DMA transfer, validates CNN embedding vector, and verifies Distance IP outputs Match=1.
Check full autonomous pipeline classifying an anomaly image: DMA copy -> CNN inference -> Distance Anomaly.
Loads divergent reference embedding, triggers Distance IP, validates RESULT==0 (ANOMALY), logs PASS.
Scoreboard verifies Distance IP outputs Dist=800, Result=0, and flags anomaly detection.
Check system completion handshake via DMEM mailbox (0x1000_FF00) and final GPIO output pin state (0x00000055).
Writes 0xCAFE0001 to MAILBOX_REG (0x1000_FF00); drives GPIO_OUT = 0x00000055; enters sleep.
Testbench samples physical gpio_o pins for 0x00000055 and checks DMEM mailbox holds 0xCAFE0001 before exiting.
External (Drives physical gpio_o pins & internal mailbox)
